items.title: Dick Katz interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: It was Tyree Glenn, Papa Jo Jones who was the real leader, Tyree was the front man, and Tommy Potter.

ctx.x: That’s right. He was a magician. Not that Tatum — so Hank says, “Can you go on and take this” so it turned out to be like two months or something. It was Tyree Glenn, Papa Jo Jones who was the real leader, Tyree was the front man, and Tommy Potter. And it was very well structured and Jo didn’t care too much for Tyree I think because Tyree used to really lay it on thick.
